iOS 15 Night Mode repair: preflight the device's real MPV audio filters on local synthetic PCM before playing videos. Try acompressor then compand; if unavailable, leave Night Mode OFF and preserve normal playback, without an audio-filter error screen. New OFF-by-default iOS Settings opt-in sends only redacted, allowlisted audio failure codes and codec details to private mghazalyh/torriodb; manual upload also available. No movie names, URLs or tokens. iOS only; Windows Build #153 unchanged.
